rows.note: Narrow dip fixed at ~6.168 GHz from -55 up to ~-10 dBm, then a chaotic/bistable band at -8..0 dBm (fit failed, dressed SNR 3.0). Transition region is broad and noisy; bare branch barely established above it. Not C3 since the high-power chaos shows the feature does respond to power.
Dressed dip at ~6.1005 GHz at low power, bare branch at ~6.0975 above ~-30 dBm, transition visible ~-30..-35; optimal -39.5 dBm sits below it. Clean punch-out.
Dressed ~6.0027, bare ~6.0001, transition ~-30..-35 dBm, optimal -37.1 below it. Somewhat noisy but both branches and crossover clear.

Bare 6.0120 at high power, dressed ~6.0148 below ~-35; crossover is a gradual diagonal (-27..-35) but continuous and both branches distinct; optimal -48.2 well below. Borderline toward C4 on crossover width, but I read it clean.

Dressed band 6.0143 terminates at ~-31 dBm inside the window; bare landing (6.0120) partly hidden behind the annotation box but the punch-out itself is evidenced. Optimal -35.3 below the transition. Transition is near the top edge — borderline but C1.
Single dip fixed at ~6.0125 GHz (= the bare freq from #313/#317) over the full -70..-20 dBm span; no dressed branch anywhere even at the lowest power. Feature does not shift with power.

Figure shows a clean punch-out: dressed ~6.0163 below ~-33, bare ~6.0125 above ~-30, fairly sharp jump — even though the node's own fit failed on dressed-dip SNR (1.9). Taxonomy applied to the figure, not the fit outcome.
Dip shifts ~6.014 (low power) to ~6.010 (high power) through a broad smeared crossover at -28..-33 dBm; trace spikes wildly at the boundaries. Branches visible, crossover not sharp.
Crisp bare band 6.010 at 0..-27 dBm; weak, wider dressed region ~6.013 at -32..-50 with a noisy non-sharp crossover (fit failed, SNR 2.9). A small shift IS discernible, so C4 rather than C3.
Dip fixed at ~5.9975 GHz across the whole -20..-40 dBm window (which spans where sibling runs punched out); no dressed branch at the floor. Feature does not shift — bare-only / power floor too high.

Narrow well-defined dip at ~4.9825 GHz constant from -50 to the -25 dBm ceiling — no transition in window, so bare freq/optimal power undetermined (node itself says 'no punch-out: widen sweep'). Secondary observation: a broad dark band ~4.953 + bright band ~4.967 look like background ripple, not a second resonator line, so I did not headline C5.
Smooth dark-to-bright gradient plus noise; no dip anywhere; the trace just tracks noise (fit failed, SNR 2.8). Empty window.

overall: 12/12 agree. All twelve figures were located via the rvp_batch JSONs and classified blind from figures.power_dbm.png before comparing with the claimed case. Most rows were clear-cut; the genuinely borderline ones were #8/q9 (C4 vs C3 — resolved C4 because the high-power chaotic band shows the feature responds to power), #313 and #317 (C1 vs C4 on crossover width/edge-of-window transition — both read clean), #343 (C4 vs C3 — a small dressed shift is discernible), and CQT #43 (C2 vs C5 — the extra broad bands read as background ripple, not a second resonator line). No disagreements with the claimed classification.
